CREATE TABLE subtitles (
    _id      INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    _data    TEXT,
    lang     TEXT,
    _size     INTEGER,

    UNIQUE ( video_id, file_id )  ON CONFLICT IGNORE 
)
